ARC-CO math, per acre
    PLC math, per acre

      Calculation inputs

      FSA's 2025 prices, $/bu. The 2025/26 marketing-year average (MYA) prices are FSA's final figures.

      Crop Eff. ref. ARC bench Loan MYA PLC rate
      ARC-CO guarantee 90% of benchmark revenue ARC-CO cap 12% of benchmark revenue Paid on 85% of base acres PLC yield 75% of RMA's expected county yield

      How this is calculated

      For 2025 only, FSA pays each farm the higher of ARC-CO or PLC for each crop, no matter which program was elected. Amounts are per base acre and include the 85% payment-acre factor. FSA typically begins issuing 2025 payments in October 2026.

      ARC-CO: the county's actual yield × the higher of the MYA price or loan rate gives actual revenue. If that falls below the 90% revenue guarantee, the shortfall is paid, capped at 12% of benchmark revenue. Where FSA has already posted a county's rate, the map uses FSA's figure.

      PLC: the effective reference price minus the higher of the MYA price or loan rate, times the farm's PLC yield. PLC yields are set per farm, so the map uses 75% of RMA's 2025 expected county yield for the chosen practice (the yield behind ECO and Area Plan; for wheat, spring wheat in Minnesota and North Dakota and winter wheat elsewhere, where RMA has it) as a stand-in. Enter your own PLC yield on a county for an estimate for your farm.

      Sources: USDA FSA 2025 ARC-CO county data and 2025 price tables (September 30, 2026); USDA RMA 2025 actuarial data. Estimates only, before sequestration and payment limits; your FSA office determines actual payments.
